You are comparing yourself with survivors, not the full audition list.

How many unseen attempts might sit behind the visible success?

Catch how the visible outcome changes once invisible attempts are allowed back in.

Success stories are easy to see; non-surviving attempts rarely advertise themselves.

Visible winners are not the same thing as visible odds.

A huge problem can make a real small benefit feel emotionally zero.

Does helping one person feel less worthwhile when you remember the thousand you cannot help?

TWIST
Catch scale turning effectiveness into futility.

WIN
Awareness of those not helped can reduce willingness to produce a genuine partial benefit.

MIND BEND
Incomplete help is not identical to ineffective help.
